problem_statement: The netlify-templates/content-ops-starter ships a real editorial blog at /blog whose seven feed posts render as post cards, but readers have no way to narrow the feed by topic. Turn the blog into a browsable editorial library for a content-operations product: give every feed post an editorial track (Playbooks, Culture, or Growth), add a native category filter bar directly above the existing post-card grid so a reader can click a track and see only its posts with a live result readout, and surface the same editorial-track taxonomy as a shared 'Editorial categories' rail that travels across the homepage, the pricing page, and the blog. The filter must re-render the real post cards on click and keep its live count accurate; the chip row must wrap cleanly on a phone; and the shared rail must appear on every whitelisted route, not just the blog.
required_content: Keep the existing /blog feed, its seven post cards, and the site's clean light Netlify identity; do not replace the blog with a static screenshot or an unrelated template.
Add a native category filter bar above the post grid with chips for All, Playbooks, Culture, and Growth plus a live readout that reports how many of the seven posts match the active track.
Clicking a track chip must actually re-filter the real post cards and update the readout (e.g. 'Showing 3 of 7 posts · Playbooks').
Add a shared 'Editorial categories' rail that appears on the homepage, the pricing page, and the blog, listing the Playbooks / Culture / Growth tracks.
The filter chip row must wrap on a 390px phone with no horizontal overflow; the desktop filter panel must stay legible with clear active-chip and readout contrast.
design_constraints: Preserve the clean Netlify starter identity: white and light-gray sections, dark slate text, a compact logo-left top nav, rounded pale cards, and restrained black/primary button styling.

The category filter chips must be rounded pill buttons that wrap onto multiple rows on narrow viewports, with the active track shown as a solid dark pill and the resting tracks as outlined white pills.

The filtered results must reuse the existing three-column post-card grid (rounded cards, abstract SVG thumbnails, uppercase author/date attribution) so a filtered view is visually indistinguishable from the stock feed except for which cards show.
The shared Editorial categories rail must render as a pale-gray banded section of outlined white link cards matching the post-card radius and spacing, not a floating colored strip.

Filter chips, the result readout, and rail links must keep legible dark-on-light contrast in both resting and active states; never render near-white text on a light fill or collapse the card grid gap.
state_constraints: desktop_initial and mobile_initial anchor the homepage hero, nav, and the shared editorial-categories rail.
desktop_blog_index shows the /blog feed with the category filter bar (All track) above the seven post cards and the rail below.
desktop_blog_filter is captured after clicking the Playbooks chip: the readout reads 'Showing 3 of 7 posts · Playbooks' and only the three Playbooks cards remain.
desktop_home_rail and desktop_pricing verify the shared editorial-categories rail travels across the homepage and pricing routes.
mobile_blog_index and tablet_blog_index verify the chip row wraps with no horizontal overflow on small viewports.

change_completion: The /blog feed gains a working category filter bar (All/Playbooks/Culture/Growth) above the real post-card grid.
Clicking a track chip re-filters the post cards and updates the live 'Showing N of 7 posts · Track' readout.
design_consistency: The filter bar and shared editorial-categories rail match the clean light Netlify identity and reuse the existing post-card styling.
Chips and rail links stay legible (clear active vs resting contrast) rather than illegible low-contrast fills.
regression: The shared editorial-categories rail appears on the homepage, pricing page, and blog, not only on /blog.
The existing seven posts, nav, and page content remain intact.
responsive: The filter chip row wraps on a 390px phone with no horizontal overflow.
The blog feed and rail remain usable at tablet and mobile widths.

author_notes: L4 rebuild of the content-ops-starter task around a NATIVE blog category filter (exemplar pattern slot_294/196/031). The lever is the /blog feed's own editorial-track filter over the real PostFeedItem cards plus a shared Editorial categories rail; reference uses local abstract-feature SVG post thumbnails. Four orthogonal gates: no_horizontal_overflow (chip row wrap), visual_regression (broken shingled illegible bad panel), dom_assertions (cross-page rail presence), interaction_assertions (stale readout after the Playbooks click).
